chung.Syllabus Name: Visual Design Tools _Công cụ thiết kế trực quan
chung.Description:
The course empowers students to master 3 most common Adobe 2D tools for graphic designers, which are Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign, so that they can finalize their 2D designs better.
Through practical assignments, students get to apply the concepts they've learned in other courses, like: color, typography, shape creation, photography, composition and layout etc. by using computers and design tools to create graphic applications.
Adobe Illustrator: Turn out professional-looking graphics for web or print. Through practical exercises, become fluent in the premier program for line art, logos, vector graphics and quick page layout as well as tricks and time efficient techniques to keep work clean and professional.
Adobe Photoshop: Best for editing and enhancing raster images, like photos, with tools for retouching, compositing, and digital painting.
Adobe InDesign: Used for designing layouts for print and digital media, such as magazines, brochures, and more.
chung.StudentTasks:
- Read textbook and install software before coming to class
- Complete assignments in class, submit online throughout LMS or Classroom platform.
- Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course.
- Actively participate into class, review and comments to classmate works, ask instructor questions, bring into class everyday samples for references.
- Complete homework and other requirements by instructors
- Using laptop in class only for taking note, research and doing assignment purposes
- No talking, surfing, chatting, gaming, facebooking, using phone etc. while the teacher giving instruction.
- Present at least 80% class attendance in order to pass the course.
chung.Tools:
1. The school prepare (Installed):
- Classroom with chairs, desks, large monitor with HDMI connection for demo/presentation
2. Student prepare:
- Note/Sketchbooks, pens and pencils
- Laptop for graphic design with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign installed
- Suitable Generative AI tools
Students are required to use their personal account (not the university or organizational account) to register for an Adobe account.

clo: Understanding of vector, bitmap, and layout principles, together with essential design principles as the basis for creating effective 2D design products.
Apply Adobe Illustrator proficiently to create vector-based design products such as logos, icons, and illustrations.
Apply Adobe Photoshop proficiently to develop bitmap-based design products such as photo edits, digital paintings, and visual effects.
Apply Adobe InDesign proficiently to produce layout-based publishing products such as brochures, magazines, and posters.
Apply AI tools and demonstrate AI literacy to collaborate effectively.
Having a positive attitude and a professional working style.

⚠️ Trường KHÔNG công bố link cho 'Adobe Design Basics' — chỉ ghi tên và nguồn Creative Commons. Đừng bịa link.
Trường KHÔNG ghi CLO cho từng đầu điểm (cột CLO của bảng đánh giá để trống) — nói là trường không công bố, đừng suy diễn.
Trường KHÔNG ghi thời lượng/tiêu chí đạt cho Participation. Cột 'Note' của môn ghi giá trị '5' không rõ nghĩa.
